metadata.title: Fractured Portraiture with High Contrast Lighting

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-key portrait viewed through a web of shattered glass that physically distorts and segments the subject's features.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, three-quarter profile of a heavily tattooed man, captured through a pane of cracked glass. The lighting is dramatic and directional, creating a sharp rim light against a dark, textured background, while the glass fractures create a chaotic web of white lines that intersect with the subject's facial features and tattoos.
coreVisualRelationships: Shattered glass lines intersecting facial contours
High-contrast rim light separating subject from dark background
Detailed skin textures and tattoos contrasting with smooth glass surfaces
Fractured perspective creating a sense of psychological tension

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject occupies the majority of the frame, positioned slightly off-center in a tight close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The intersection of the glass cracks near the center of the face, drawing the eye to the subject's expression.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the sharp white lines of the glass cracks across the face, moving from the bright rim light on the hair down to the shadowed beard.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows in the background and lower corners provide high contrast for the white glass fractures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black (shadows and background)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Cool white and silver (rim light and glass cracks)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and amber highlights on the beard
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with extreme value contrast between deep blacks and bright highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to monochromatic tones with subtle warm skin accents

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, low-key portrait of a man with facial tattoos and a beard, lit with a strong cool-toned rim light against a dark textured wall. Ensure high detail in skin and hair textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a high-resolution transparent overlay of shattered glass with a central impact point. The cracks should be bright white and sharp, physically segmenting the portrait underneath.

verificationChecks: Glass cracks appear on top of the subject
Rim light is sharp and distinct
Tattoos are visible through the glass fractures

mustAchieve: Sharp focus on the glass texture
Tangible sense of depth between glass and subject

postGenerationChecks: Does the glass look physically broken rather than just a line drawing?
Is the lighting directional and dramatic?
Are the textures of the skin and hair sharp?
Is the background sufficiently dark to make the cracks pop?
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait through [Material: Shattered Glass] + [Lighting: High Contrast Rim Light] + [Subject: Gritty Character] + [Color: Desaturated Low-Key]
